images.name: encocado
images.prompt:
Correct the FOOD GEOMETRY and SAUCE in the first reference image, the existing encocado, while keeping exactly the same gouache + pencil illustration style as both supplied references. The dish is SHIITAKE CAPS CUT INTO HALVES, STEWED IN COCONUT SAUCE. The user specifically requires HALVES, not thin slices, not stuffed mushrooms. Remove the existing mushroom shapes and replace them with 8–10 recognizable thick HALF-CAPS of shiitake, cooked and tender, with the stems removed before cutting. Each mushroom cap has been cut once straight down its center, leaving a substantial semicircular piece: rounded brown convex cap skin on the outside, one clearly visible STRAIGHT cut face of soft pale-beige flesh. Some halves lie cap-side UP so we see the broad brown half-dome and their straight cut edge; a few are tipped naturally showing the pale gilled underside. The cut cap halves are three-dimensional and substantial, not narrow C-shaped slices, not the repeated iconic whole-mushroom cross-section with a long stalk, not whole circular caps, not hollow cups or stuffed caps. Natural varied orientations, more brown cooked cap surfaces than exposed bright gills. Partly submerged in the sauce. Draw with convincing cooked shiitake anatomy. Keep mushrooms prominent, appetizing, and in proportion to the bowl.

Replace the granular surface with a SMOOTH, SILKY, COHESIVE coconut-and-tomato sauce, light warm ivory with just a soft pale-gold tint from 0.25 teaspoon turmeric in 400ml coconut milk. Broad smooth areas of sauce MUST be visible between the mushrooms. A few very small softened cooked tomato and onion pieces, restrained tiny cilantro garnish. The sauce is thick enough to coat the mushrooms but still flows around them: NO rice, rice-like granules, grains, lentils, cheese, potatoes, yellow cubes, dumplings, loose solid toppings, raw purple onion rings, or mounded filling. This is a coconut mushroom stew, NOT risotto, curry rice, soup with chunks, or stuffed mushrooms. No rice in this bowl; it is optional on the side and is omitted from this illustration.

Preserve the EXACT same original opaque hand-painted gouache and sparse pencil contours, visible restrained dry-brush strokes on the FOOD AND CERAMIC but not rice-like texture in the sauce, same cream speckled ceramic bowl with thin ochre rim, same square composition, elevated three-quarter view, complete centered bowl at the same scale. Match the original flat warm paper background near #FAF8F3, no new background props, no text, no collage, no photography, no 3D, no new art direction. Second reference is style only: DO NOT copy its arepa, corn, avocado or plate content.
images.encoding: WebP calidad 86; mismas dimensiones y encuadre.
images.review: Mitades gruesas de sombrero, sin tallos largos ni relleno, en salsa de coco; ilustración orientativa, no prueba de cocina.
